lines.translation: Only a few, as Gurmukh, remembered the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਇ ਪਗ ਧਰਮੁ ਧਰੇ ਧਰਣੀਧਰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਤਿਥਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: dui pag dharam dhare dharaneedhar guramukh saach tithaaee he ||8||
lines.translation: Dharmic faith, which upholds and supports the earth, had only two feet; Truth was revealed to the Gurmukhs. ||8||
The kings acted righteously only out of self-interest.
Tied to hopes of reward, they gave to charities.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਥਾਕੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam bin mukat na hoee thaake karam kamaaee he ||9||
lines.translation: Without the Lord's Name, liberation did not come, although they grew weary of performing rituals. ||9||
Practicing religious rituals, they sought liberation,
but the treasure of liberation comes only by praising the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਰਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: bin gurasabadai mukat na hoee parapa(n)ch kar bharamaaee he ||10||
lines.translation: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, liberation is not obtained; practicing hypocrisy, they wander around confused. ||10||
Love and attachment to Maya cannot be abandoned.
They alone find release, who practice deeds of Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: ahinis bhagat rate veechaaree thaakur siu ban aaee he ||11||
lines.translation: Day and night, the devotees remain imbued with contemplative meditation; they become just like their Lord and Master. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਵਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik jap tap kar kar teerath naavahi ||
lines.translation: Some chant and practice intensive meditation, and take cleansing baths at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
They walk as You will them to walk.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਠਿ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਅਪਤੀਜੁ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਨਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: hath nigrahi apateej na bheejai bin har gur kin pat paaee he ||12||
lines.translation: By stubborn rituals of self-suppression, the Lord is not pleased. No one has ever obtained honor, without the Lord, without the Guru. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲੀ ਕਾਲ ਮਹਿ ਇਕ ਕਲ ਰਾਖੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kalee kaal mahi ik kal raakhee ||
lines.translation: In the Iron Age, the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, only one power remains.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਭਾਖੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin gur poore kinai na bhaakhee ||
lines.translation: Without the Perfect Guru, no one has even described it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh kooR varatai varataaraa bin satigur bharam na jaaee he ||13||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs have staged the show of falsehood. Without the True Guru, doubt does not depart. ||13||
The True Guru is the Creator Lord, independent and carefree.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਜਮ ਕਾਣਿ ਨ ਛੰਦਾ ਬੰਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa jam kaan na chha(n)daa ba(n)daa ||
lines.translation: He does not fear death, and He is not dependent on mortal men.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੰਤਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: jo tis seve so abinaasee naa tis kaal sa(n)taaee he ||14||
lines.translation: Whoever serves Him becomes immortal and imperishable, and will not be tortured by death. ||14||
The Creator Lord has enshrined Himself within the Guru.
The Gurmukh saves countless millions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: sarab jeeaa jagajeevan daataa nirabhau mail na kaaee he ||15||
lines.translation: The Life of the World is the Great Giver of all beings. The Fearless Lord has no filth at all. ||15||
Everyone begs from the Guru, God's Treasurer.
He Himself is the immaculate, unknowable, infinite Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਚੈ ਮੈ ਦੀਜੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਰਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak saach kahai prabh jaachai mai deejai saach rajaaee he ||16||4||
lines.translation: Nanak speaks the Truth; he begs from God. Please bless me with the Truth, by Your Will. ||16||4||
Maaroo, First Mehl:
The True Lord unites with those who are united with the Word of the Shabad.
When it pleases Him, we intuitively merge with Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਜੋਤਿ ਧਰੀ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tribhavan jot dharee paramesar avar na doojaa bhaaee he ||1||
lines.translation: The Light of the Transcendent Lord pervades the three worlds; there is no other at all, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਚਾਕਰ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis ke chaakar tis kee sevaa ||
lines.translation: I am His servant; I serve Him.
He is unknowable and mysterious; He is pleased by the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ਕਰਤਾ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: bhagataa kaa gunakaaree karataa bakhas lae vadiaaee he ||2||
lines.translation: The Creator is the Benefactor of His devotees. He forgives them - such is His greatness. ||2||
The True Lord gives and gives; His blessings never run short.
The false ones receive, and then deny having received.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੂਲੁ ਨ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਨ ਰੀਝਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: mool na boojhahi saach na reejhahi doojai bharam bhulaaee he ||3||
lines.translation: They do not understand their origins, they are not pleased with the Truth, and so they wander in duality and doubt. ||3||
The Gurmukhs remain awake and aware, day and night.
Following the Guru's Teachings, they know the Love of the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸੋਇ ਰਹੇ ਸੇ ਲੂਟੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਭਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh soi rahe se loote guramukh saabat bhaaee he ||4||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs remain asleep, and are plundered. The Gurmukhs remain safe and sound, O Siblings of Destiny. ||4||
The false come, and the false go;
imbued with falsehood, they practice only falsehood.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: sabad mile se daragah paidhe guramukh surat samaaee he ||5||
lines.translation: Those who are imbued with the Shabad are robed in honor in the Court of the Lord; the Gurmukhs focus their consciousness on Him. ||5||
The false are cheated, and robbed by the robbers.
The garden is laid waste, like the rough wilderness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਦਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਿਐ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: naam binaa kichh saad na laagai har bisariai dukh paaee he ||6||
lines.translation: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, nothing tastes sweet; forgetting the Lord, they suffer in sorrow. ||6||
Receiving the food of Truth, one is satisfied.
True is the glorious greatness of the jewel of the Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੀਨੈ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: cheenai aap pachhaanai soee jotee jot milaaee he ||7||
lines.translation: One who understands his own self, realizes the Lord. His light merges into the Light. ||7||
